_comment: Names this engine emits as preferred that the pinned reference parser ACCEPTS and then
reads as a different molecule, because it numbers the same ring system differently.
This is deliberately NOT the rejection waiver in reviewed_parser_gaps.json, and it must
not be merged into it: an expected rejection never licenses a mismatch, and a generic
'structure mismatch' label would hide whether the defect belongs to the engine or to the
parser. The label names what is actually in dispute - the numbering of the parent.
A record waives nothing about correctness. The raw outcome stays 'mismatched': the parser
match metric and the structural verification helper never report it as a round trip. Only
the release gate may treat it as a reviewed interoperability discrepancy.
The evidential burden is higher than for a rejection, because the disputed numbering is
the very thing under review. An engine reconstruction that consumes the same atom-to-locant
map that produced the name only shows internal consistency. Every record therefore carries
an INDEPENDENTLY derived numbered parent graph, and names the source that derived it.
The record applies only when all of these hold at once: the expected name is unchanged, the
intended structure is unchanged, the tested parser environment matches the pinned one, and
the parser returns exactly the recorded wrong interpretation. Any other parser response -
a correct reading, a different wrong reading, a rejection, a timeout, a crash - is NOT
covered and fails loudly. A changed response makes a record stale, never successful.

field_notes.disputed_numbering: The complete numbered parent graph, derived independently of the engine: every locant with its element, and the ring bonds written as locant pairs. Copying the engine's own map here defeats the record.
field_notes.drawing_record: Why that numbering is the preferred one under the rules, in order: permitted ring shapes, the shared edges forming the maximum horizontal row, the orientation/quadrant comparison, the selected uppermost-rightmost starting ring, the most counterclockwise nonfusion starting atom, the clockwise perimeter, and the surviving alternatives with the criterion that separated them.
field_notes.derivative_reconstruction: Independent reconstruction of the COMPLETE derivative, not the parent alone: substitution, hydrogen state, charge and stereochemistry.
field_notes.independent_source: What derived the numbering and reconstruction, and why it is independent of the engine under review. It need not be another naming engine; a hand-checked drawing with a separate reconstruction script qualifies. Reusing the engine's selected map does not.
field_notes.preference_evidence: rule_derived - a published whole-name PIN would not be in dispute.
